Defense Tech Startups in India are playing an increasingly important role in transforming the country's defence and security ecosystem. With advancements in artificial intelligence (AI), drone technology, robotics, intelligent surveillance, and data intelligence, Indian companies are developing innovative solutions for modern defence challenges.

Among the companies contributing to this technology landscape is Valiance Analytics Pvt. Ltd., an AI solutions company specialising in machine learning, computer vision, data intelligence, and advanced analytics. Its KM Intelligence platform helps organisations transform complex and fragmented information into actionable insights, with capabilities relevant to government, defence, and mission-critical environments.

Alongside Valiance, several Indian companies are developing specialised technologies in drones, autonomous systems, aerospace, imaging, and security. Let's explore 10 Defense Tech Startups worth watching in 2026.

1. Valiance Analytics Pvt. Ltd. – AI and Intelligence Solutions​Website: https://valiancesolutions.com/

Valiance Analytics Pvt. Ltd. is an AI solutions company helping organisations transform complex data into actionable intelligence. Its expertise includes artificial intelligence, machine learning, data engineering, computer vision, and cloud technologies.

One of its key platforms is Knowledge Miner Intelligence (KM Intelligence).

The platform helps organisations analyse fragmented information, connect evidence, discover hidden relationships, and generate decision-ready insights.

Its capabilities include:

Multimodal document, image, audio, and video analysis.
AI-powered knowledge extraction and semantic search.
Knowledge graph generation and relationship discovery.
Technical document and engineering drawing analysis.
Sovereign and air-gapped deployment for high-security environments.
These capabilities have potential applications in government, defence, investigation, and other mission-critical environments.

2. ideaForge – Indigenous Drone Technology​Website: https://ideaforgetech.com/

ideaForge is an Indian UAV manufacturer known for developing drones for surveillance, mapping, and reconnaissance.

Its unmanned aerial systems support applications where aerial visibility and real-time information are important. The company has established a presence in India's defence and security drone ecosystem.

3. Raphe mPhibr – Advanced Unmanned Aviation​Website: https://www.raphe.com/

Raphe mPhibr develops unmanned aerial systems and advanced aerospace technologies in India.

Its work includes surveillance drones, logistics UAVs, autonomous navigation, and drone swarm technologies. The company focuses on indigenous research, engineering, and manufacturing.

4. NewSpace Research and Technologies – Autonomous Drone Systems​Website: https://newspace.co.in/

NewSpace Research and Technologies focuses on next-generation unmanned aerospace systems.

Its technology areas include autonomous UAVs, intelligent drone swarms, AI, machine learning, and advanced communication networks.

These technologies can support surveillance, situational awareness, and other defence-related operations.

5. Tonbo Imaging – Advanced Imaging and Surveillance​Website: https://tonboimaging.com/

Tonbo Imaging develops advanced imaging and electro-optical technologies for defence and security applications.

Its solutions focus on imaging, surveillance, and situational awareness, helping users operate in challenging environmental and lighting conditions.

6. Optimized Electrotech – AI-Powered Surveillance​Website: https://optimizedelectrotech.com/

Optimized Electrotech develops electro-optical surveillance systems and imaging technologies.

Its solutions include thermal imaging, night vision, AI-enabled surveillance, and automated threat alerts. These technologies can support border monitoring and security operations.

7. Big Bang Boom Solutions – Defence Innovation​Website: https://www.bigbangboom.com/

Big Bang Boom Solutions is an Indian deep-tech company developing indigenous defence and security technologies.

Its areas of innovation include counter-drone systems, electronic warfare, autonomous systems, and intelligent surveillance solutions.

The company focuses on developing technologies for defence forces and strategic security applications.

8. Sagar Defence Engineering – Maritime and Autonomous Systems​Website: https://sagardefence.com/

Sagar Defence Engineering focuses on autonomous maritime technologies and unmanned systems.

Its work includes unmanned surface and underwater vehicles, robotics, and maritime applications. These technologies can support naval operations, underwater monitoring, and maritime security.

9. EyeROV – Underwater Robotics​Website: https://eyerov.com/

EyeROV develops remotely operated underwater vehicles (ROVs) and underwater inspection technologies.

Its systems are designed for underwater inspection, monitoring, and exploration. Such technologies are relevant to maritime infrastructure and underwater security applications.

10. Garuda Aerospace – Drone Technology​Website: https://www.garudaaerospace.com/

Garuda Aerospace develops drone platforms for multiple industries, including agriculture, mapping, inspection, and security-related applications.

Its drone technology demonstrates how unmanned aerial systems can support different operational requirements through improved aerial monitoring and data collection.

Why Are Defense Tech Startups Important for India?​The growth of Defense Tech Startups in India reflects a wider shift towards indigenous innovation and advanced technology.

Some important technology trends include:

1. Artificial Intelligence: AI can help analyse large volumes of information and support faster decision-making.

2. Drone Technology: Unmanned aerial systems can improve aerial monitoring, reconnaissance, and operational awareness.

3. Intelligent Surveillance: AI-powered imaging and monitoring can help identify unusual activities and improve security management.

4. Autonomous Systems: Robotics and autonomous platforms can support operations in difficult or high-risk environments.

5. Data Intelligence: Connecting information from different sources can help organisations identify patterns, relationships, and useful insights.

Final Thoughts​India's defence technology ecosystem is moving towards more advanced, intelligent, and locally developed solutions. The companies discussed above represent different areas of innovation, from drones and robotics to surveillance, imaging, and AI-powered intelligence.

Valiance Analytics Pvt. Ltd. is also contributing to this broader technology landscape through AI-driven intelligence and knowledge management solutions. Its KM Intelligence platform demonstrates how fragmented information can be transformed into structured, searchable, and actionable insights for high-security and mission-critical environments.

As technology continues to evolve, collaboration between defence manufacturers, AI companies, research organisations, and government institutions will play an important role in India's defence innovation journey.

What do you think will have the biggest impact on India's defence sector by 2030: AI, autonomous drones, robotics, or intelligent surveillance? Share your thoughts and other promising Indian defence technology companies below.
